title: Morocco’s $5.5 Billion Royal Port Strategy Could Reshape Energy Flows
summary: Morocco’s $5.5 billion Nador West Med port could reshape Mediterranean energy flows through LNG infrastructure, hydrocarbon storage and expanded trade links.
